title: PortfolioDecisions
description: What a portfolio decided about what it holds, at its latest review: for each project, programme or portfolio, a priority and whether to invest in it, hold it or stop it, with the reason and the date. Its own file beside the portfolio, as a KPI's readings are beside the KPI (TAXONOMY.md D8): decisions change at every review while the portfolio's definition does not, and they name what the portfolio holds, which is written after it in the order of work (D28, D32).

portfolio.description: The portfolio these are the decisions of.

kind.description: What kind of thing the decision is about.

id.description: The project, programme or portfolio decided on. It should name this portfolio; a decision about something the portfolio does not hold is advised.

priority.description: Its rank in the portfolio, 1 first. Two things may share a rank.

decision.description: Invest: fund it and let it go on. Hold: keep it, but commit nothing more until it is reviewed again. Stop: end it, and release what it holds.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence a reader would accept: what it advances, or what has to change first.

decisions.description: One decision per thing the portfolio holds; one each (a kind rule).
